bodyInitial.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production-ready single 2D water-magic projectile sprite texture for a small casual fantasy Unity game. Primary request: one simple round water orb, readable at only 16 to 32 pixels on screen, matching a cute chibi purple-robed mage, cream-and-gold UI, bright green meadow, and rounded cel-painted slime enemies. Medium: clean hand-painted cartoon game sprite with restrained, broad cel shading, not photorealism and not detailed 3D. A nearly circular irregular water sphere, pale icy cyan face of the sphere, turquoise lower edge and a restrained dark desaturated teal contour, one small white crescent reflection upper left and one tiny highlight. Only 3 or 4 broad color regions. No eyes, mouth, character, lettering, symbols, pedestal, glow aura, sparkles, flying droplets, environment, or extra objects. Composition: a SINGLE orb perfectly centered in a square image, full silhouette occupying about 80% of width and height, generous symmetric transparent margins, no cast shadow. Keep silhouette crisp with light anti-aliasing and minimal inner detail; do not add ripples, filigree or decorative swirls. Background: genuinely transparent RGBA, absolutely no background color, no checkerboard. This is a neutral-facing round sprite which will rotate or travel in any direction, so no directional tail baked into the image. Intended reference style is existing rounded casual game sprites; reproduce the restrained palette and clear silhouette, do not reproduce a character face. Output one sprite, not a sprite sheet, no labels.

bodyFinal.prompt: Edit only this water orb sprite to make it a clean, flat CEL-SHADED casual-fantasy game projectile, readable at tiny gameplay size. Keep the same single rounded silhouette, its position, overall turquoise and pale icy cyan palette, thick restrained dark teal outer contour and upper-left white crescent highlight. CRITICAL: replace the dark grainy translucent center with one smooth solid pale cyan flat color continuous with the upper half, no hole, no transparency or dark shading INSIDE the orb. Keep all interior pixels fully opaque except antialiasing at the exterior contour. Remove all grain, noise, speckling, dithering, texture, atmospheric shading, glow and gradients; use only three or four broad clean flat color regions with crisp organic boundaries. Bottom-right darker turquoise broad cel-shade only; no central shading. Preserve the transparent exterior and generous margins. No face, no extra objects, no text, no symbols, no background, no checkerboard. Output one transparent-background PNG sprite, not a sheet.

trail.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: PRODUCTION Unity TrailRenderer grayscale ALPHA MASK texture for a tiny stylized fantasy waterball projectile, not an illustration or preview. Create a horizontal 2:1 rectangular image, about 1024 by 512. Transparent RGBA background. One single straight horizontal white watery ribbon centered vertically, extending completely from left image boundary to right image boundary, with almost the same vertical cross-section at both ends so it can repeat seamlessly along X. Ribbon occupies the middle 55 percent of image height; top and bottom 22 percent are fully transparent. Restrained smooth hand-painted cel-game style matching rounded cartoon fantasy spells, clean tiny-scale readable shape. White grayscale only, no blue color (the game supplies cyan color), black areas must instead be actual transparency. A broad soft-edged white center band with just two subtle thin flowing lighter streaks and slightly organic upper and lower edges, no hard black outlines. Smoothly fade alpha toward upper and lower ribbon edges. Do NOT taper to a point at either horizontal end: the TrailRenderer controls its own taper and length. No flare, no stars, no droplets, no balls, no swirl coils, no ocean scene, no water splash, no spray, no typography, no frames, no background color, no checkerboard. The white flowing strip must touch BOTH the left and right edge continuously. Return only this utilitarian single mask image.
